Create a deck. Title: Connectivity Map OKRs. One slide for each objective, the title is the objective and a text box with the KRs.
Objective 1: Clarify who the map serves. KR1: Document users. KR2: Find a long-term owner.
Objective 2: Deploy the multi-sector map. KR1: Health data in 3 countries. KR2: Telemetry pilot.
Objective 3: Public advocacy tools. KR1: Interactive map test. KR2: Visibility metrics.
Objective 4: Government advocacy map. KR1: Ministry requirements. KR2: Rebrand.
Objective 5: Stabilize the platform. KR1: Monitoring baseline. KR2: Usability upgrades.
